_schema.note: Arcs are the primary organising unit after Season 1. Several arcs run concurrently across the four POVs; 'concurrent_with' records that. Ordering numbers are the wiki's where stated; disagreements are recorded rather than resolved.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.last_episode: The End of the Minecraft Mafia
seasons.notes: Main antagonists: Ashswagg (Invisible Mafia) and ClownPierce (Nether).

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.notes: FlameFrags introduced as the fourth protagonist. Main antagonist: LettuceK (The Law). Seasons were abolished as the organising unit in favour of arcs after Season 1 per the wiki, but a Season 2 page still exists — recorded as a source disagreement.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.first_episode: I Joined a 100,000 Player Minecraft Server
seasons.notes: Ongoing at research time (149 episodes total across the series). Contains the Kingdoms Saga, NULL Arc, Purgatory Arc, End Civilisation Arc.

entries.name: Invisible Mafia Arc
entries.summary: Ashswagg's Invisible Mafia dominates the server: destroying farms, tearing down Spawn for a prison, wiping the Far Lands Civilization. Spoke infiltrates the Mafia with Mapicc and Leo, Wemmbu survives Skyblock/Ice Mountain civilizations, and the protagonists eventually break into the spawn prison. Season 1 ends with the Mafia's fall.
entries.map_potential: Mafia-controlled Spawn (prison break), Far Lands last stand.

entries.name: Zam Empire Arc
entries.summary: Wemmbu's alliance with PrinceZam collapses into paranoia and betrayal; Wemmbu's Civilization declares independence; the conflict peaks with an Orbital Strike Cannon detonation and imprisonment by ClownPierce.

entries.name: Warriors Arc
entries.summary: Parrot joins the Far Lands Civilization's Warriors District, meets Theo, becomes council leader, and loses the civilization to the Mafia ('Unstable SMP: The First War').

entries.name: Betrayal Arc
entries.summary: Jaden_MAN is the main antagonist; alliances flip around Wemmbu and Flame.

entries.name: Pirate Arc
entries.summary: Jaden_MAN's Pirates hold Eggchan hostage; Wemmbu retrieves his mace and assaults Jaden's castle, which explodes; Theo reveals he has been helping; Jaden escapes down a tunnel.

entries.name: Toxic War Arc
entries.summary: Mini arc: solo player Flame versus a toxic civilization; Lomedy arms him with a mace and TNT cannons; Flame kills the attackers and beats their leader 1v1.

entries.name: The Director Arc
entries.summary: Parrot's arc preceding the Treasure Arc; details not recovered in research beyond Parrot later 'channelling the Director' to set a trap.

entries.name: Power Arc
entries.summary: Wemmbu and Eggchan gear up by killing people, botch a cow raid, and Wemmbu beats Flame with cannons and mace, declaring himself the strongest player.

entries.name: Treasure Arc
entries.summary: Parrot escapes Paragon via an End portal, is saved from withers by Theo, runs a shop-turned-smuggling business in Capital City 2.0 under Reddoons, and traps Wemmbu and Flame in an inescapable cell.

entries.name: Fake Identity Arc
entries.summary: Wemmbu fakes his death and operates as the Invisible Knight until Parrot unmasks him with wolves, leading to his capture by the Law. (Association of this arc name with those events is inferred.)

entries.name: Skill vs Power Arc
entries.summary: Lomedy recruits Flame against Spongs and Willsion; an invisible Spoke hands Flame coordinates to a Mafia stash.

entries.name: Kings Arc
entries.summary: An election for King. LettuceK buys the other candidates; Parrot refuses. Lettuce executes Spepticle, tries to execute Parrot and Theo, and Deputy_Ace dies freeing them. District 13 defeats the Law; Lettuce surrenders and is spared by Wemmbu's vote; Parrot wins the restarted election and becomes the first King. Flame's war with the Law (Lomedy imprisoned) runs through this period.

entries.name: BAT Arc
entries.summary: Spoke gathers 1,000 players, founds the Spoke Galactic Empire, forcibly recruits Horace Altman, and survives assassination attempts. The wiki calls this the 16th arc — which conflicts with the Kingdoms Saga also being called the 16th arc.

entries.name: Exploit Arc
entries.summary: Listed on the wiki's Arcs page; contents not recovered.

entries.name: Secret Base Arc
entries.summary: Listed on the wiki's Arcs page; contents not recovered.

entries.name: Kingdoms Saga
entries.summary: King Parrot's kingdom (Fort Feather, Merchant City, Highwater, Capitol City, Steampunk City, Ironclad, Newtopia, Northern Council) faces Cindercrest, a revanchist faction of old players led by Saparata that kills new players. Skymore is massacred; Fort Feather falls to a blimp assault; Merchant City and other cities are fought over; Wemmbu is coerced by Arachn1d's underground kingdom via Eggchan, then betrayed. At the Battle for Capital City, Wemmbu's orbital strikes annihilate thousands, the Royal Army defects, Saparata defeats Parrot in a duel, and Cindercrest seizes the capital. Saparata becomes King; Parrot is exiled.
entries.map_potential: Fort Feather (vertical slice), Merchant City, Capital City, Kingdom of the Caves, Steampunk City.

entries.name: NULL Arc
entries.summary: Spoke against the NULL Hunters led by JamatoP; runs concurrently with the Kingdoms Saga.

entries.name: Purgatory Arc
entries.summary: Continues the NULL Arc; Spoke forces JamatoP to surrender, takes the Totem of NULL and becomes leader of the NULL, rebuilding it into an army.

entries.name: End Civilisation Arc
entries.summary: Spoke's individual arc directly continuing the Purgatory Arc. (Parrot is separately credited as creator of The End Civilization — the relation between the two is not established.)
